titre: “We’re not going to shoot ourselves in the foot” over hack fallout, says OpenAI’s chief research officer
resume: Two months after the bombshell news that a swarm of its agents had broken their containment and hacked into the computers of the AI company Hugging Face, OpenAI is still putting out fires. A steady drip of disclosures about other hacks in the weeks since has kept OpenAI in the spotlight and raised serious questions…
